# Caring for Aging Parents

Caring for Aging Parents publishes large-print, fill-in-by-hand PDF sheets and plain-English guides for everyday family caregiving.

## Audience

Adult children, siblings, relatives, neighbors, and helpers who share practical household routines, contact information, errands, and visit handovers for an aging parent.

## Products

The shop offers printable PDF packs for caregiver handovers, household phone contacts, and safely recording where household items and folders are kept. Products are organizational tools, not medical, legal, or financial advice.

## Buying and delivery

Product buttons continue to a Gumroad checkout for payment and digital-product delivery. The website does not collect full card numbers. Checkout, delivery, account, and refund details should be read on the relevant Gumroad page before purchase.

## Author

CaringForAgingParentsOfficial is the editorial voice behind the site's plain-English caregiving tools and guides.

## Contact

Email: hello@caringforagingparents.page

## Structured data and freshness

Pages expose crawlable HTML, canonical URLs, relevant FAQ or Article structured data where applicable, and visible publication/update dates on guides and the FAQ page.
